_readme: Places OpenStreetMap does not carry yet. Every row here must come from an actual survey — a coordinate someone stood at, or a feature someone saw. Nothing invented. Better still, add it to OpenStreetMap instead and it arrives here on the next `npm run fetch`, along with every other OSM consumer. Admin-mode additions can be exported to this format.

_schema.name: display name, required
_schema.cat: one of the category keys in scripts/build-data.mjs, required
_schema.lat / lon: surveyed coordinates. Use these OR `anchor`, not both.
_schema.anchor: EXACT name of an existing OSM feature to sit beside, when you know the place but not its coordinates. The build resolves the position and warns if the anchor stops matching.
_schema.desc: one line on why a student cares

items.name: DTU Gymnasium
items.desc: Indoor sports hall next to the sports complex. OSM way 350590342 carries the footprint but no category tags, so it is seeded here until mapped.

items.name: Main Sports Ground
items.desc: Outdoor fields around the sports complex. Anchored — resolve/nudge in admin mode against satellite.
